title: Jets stand to benefit from Colts' fire sale

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Jets stand to benefit from Colts' fire sale
sources.description: The Seahawks and 49ers hope to benefit in the near term from the trades they made with the Colts on Tuesday, but another team could wind up as a long-term winner.
